cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)
include("$ENV{PICO_SDK_PATH}/external/pico_sdk_import.cmake")
project(oro_usb_endpoints C CXX ASM)
pico_sdk_init()
add_executable(oro_usb_endpoints main.c)
set_target_properties(oro_usb_endpoints PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE C)
target_include_directories(oro_usb_endpoints PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR})
target_link_libraries(oro_usb_endpoints PRIVATE pico_stdlib tinyusb_device)
pico_add_extra_outputs(oro_usb_endpoints)
